scoring_justification: Tc cannot be fully recomputed from raw artifacts because the necessary intermediate process files (dos_n_ef.json, elastic_constants.json, debye_temp.json, lmto_i2.json) are not guaranteed to be present or in a standard format; therefore reported Tc values are compared to the paper-reported gold with an absolute tolerance (max(3 K, 10% of target)).

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold Tc values for the four compound/phase combinations
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper-reported GGA results: CrC WC Tc=31.12 K, MoC WC Tc=17.14 K, CrC NaCl Tc=39 K, MoC NaCl Tc=15.63 K; extracted from text and tables.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the actual reported superconducting transition temperatures; not fabricated.

outputs.description: Superconducting transition temperatures Tc (K) and associated electron‑phonon coupling constant λ and Coulomb parameter μ* for CrC and MoC in the WC and NaCl phases.

output_contract.notes: The hidden checker compares the four reported Tc values to the paper‑reported ground truth with an absolute tolerance. The lambda and mu_star values are checked for internal consistency but are not scored.

steps.description: Compares reported Tc values to paper-reported gold with tolerance max(3 K, 10% of target).
